newsitem.title: USA: PECO Peach Bottom, Pa. nuke boosting power.
newsitem.headline: PECO Peach Bottom, Pa. nuke boosting power.

text.p: PECO Energy Co's 1,100 megawatt (MW) Peach Bottom nuclear power unit 3 was operating at 26 percent of capacity and increasing power as of early Thursday, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit was "increasing power following maintenance outage," the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Peach Bottom 3, located in Delta, Pa., was shut down March 9 while operating at a reduced power level during control rod adjustments. The unit began a restart Wednesday.
The adjacent Peach Bottom nuclear power unit 2, also with a capacity of 1,100 MW, was operating at full power as of early Thursday morning, the NRC said.
